title: Phone alerts
summary: Choose which phone alerts you get, in the app under More › Notifications.

blocks.text: Alerts are chosen in the phone app, per phone: **More › Notifications**. The website has no alerts page.

items: Alerts come in groups: **Needs action** (something to do now), **Team** (chat, mentions, announcements), **Daily summary** and **Admin**.
Turn each one on or off. **Reset to recommended** goes back to the store's defaults.
Admins also set the store's defaults for everyone.
No alerts are sent between 10 PM and 7 AM store time. Alerts due then wait until morning.
You only get alerts for pages you can open.

blocks.text: Not getting alerts? Check your phone allows notifications for RetailOps, then see Phone alerts not arriving in the Help Center's Troubleshooting tab.
